name: bizplug-logistics
description: The logistics & delivery plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: shipping rate estimate and pickup request. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, coverage, cut-off times and quote requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
